recognize_zh: 紅箭頭的細胞只有單一偏心圓核，細胞質淡藍、邊緣有不規則泡狀突起，是像漿細胞的微小巨核細胞（micromegakaryocyte）；對照藍箭頭的真正漿細胞，核染色質粗、細胞質深藍且有核周淡區（hof）。
features: Micromegakaryocyte (red arrow): small cell with a single round eccentric nucleus, moderate pale-blue cytoplasm and irregular budding/blebbed cytoplasmic margins
Plasma cell (blue arrow): eccentric dense nucleus with clumped chromatin, deeply basophilic cytoplasm
Background of numerous immature granulocytic precursors (promyelocytes/myelocytes) with round to indented nuclei
Occasional hypolobated/hypogranular neutrophils and a band form
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a cellular field dominated by granulocytic precursors. A small megakaryocyte with a single round eccentric nucleus and pale blue cytoplasm with irregular budding margins is present (micromegakaryocyte), mimicking a plasma cell; a nearby true plasma cell shows denser clumped chromatin and more intensely basophilic cytoplasm. Scattered neutrophils appear hypogranular. Findings are consistent with megakaryocytic dysplasia in the setting of a therapy-related myeloid neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Plasma cells have coarse clock-face chromatin, deep basophilic cytoplasm and a perinuclear hof, whereas the micromegakaryocyte has paler cytoplasm with blebbed margins and is CD61/CD42b positive.
Blasts have fine chromatin with nucleoli and a high N:C ratio, whereas micromegakaryocytes have mature condensed chromatin and more cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Normal megakaryocyte in a reactive marrow
ddx.vs: Normal megakaryocytes are large with a lobulated nucleus, unlike this promyelocyte-sized mononuclear form.
